cohort: Fifty women aged 30-45 years with heavy menstrual bleeding (PBAC score >100) were enrolled from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The Levonorgestrel Intrauterine System (LNG-IUS) was found to be a highly effective, safe, and patient-acceptable therapy for abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB), significantly reducing menstrual blood loss and improving hematologic parameters over 30 months.
